battle.name: 清軍收復新疆之戰
battle.theater: 烏魯木齊城垣與天山南北
battle.brief: 一八七六年三月，清廷授左宗棠欽差大臣全權節制三軍，湘軍分批出關，四月抵哈密，八月十七日自古牧地缺口攻入迪化，次年三路南下取庫車、喀什噶爾。戰事全在陸上，鐵甲艦不曾參戰；同年海上正是英國鐵甲艦的年代，它凸顯清廷當年無力海防，只能靠屯田與數千里糧道撐住戰局。

kit.name: 鐵甲艦
kit.history: 木殼外面包了鐵。裝甲第一次比砲更難對付，砲塔的設計從此繞著它轉。

countries: 交戰的一方是清帝國的西征軍，另一方是浩罕汗國扶植、以洪福汗國為號的阿古柏政權與新疆各地的回民武裝。清方最高統帥為左宗棠，以欽差大臣全權節制三軍，副帥為金順；前軍主將劉錦棠所部湘軍二十五營，張曜所部十四營，徐占彪所部蜀軍五營，加上原駐新疆各據點的守軍，馬步砲軍合計一百五十餘營，總人數近八萬，真正開赴前線作戰的約五十餘營、二萬多人；後路由楊昌濬坐鎮關中與肅州籌措糧餉，張曜與黃冕在哈密主持屯田與轉運。浩罕方面，名義上仍奉清朝為宗主國的浩罕汗國自一八七〇年起由攝政阿古柏控制南疆，他於一八六七年另建洪福汗國，率兵攻陷吐魯番、迪化、瑪納斯等城，麾下有自中亞招集的安集延步騎、隨陝甘回亂西來的回民武裝，以及被強徵的維吾爾、回、漢丁壯；迪化、吐魯番、托克遜、瑪納斯、達坂城、庫車、喀什噶爾、和闐等要地分由白彥虎、馬人得、馬明等守將把守。俄羅斯與英國都不列名交戰方，卻在背後輸血：沙俄一八七一年出兵佔領伊犁，並派商隊自吐爾尕特山口把大批軍火運入喀什；英國一八七三年遣使團到喀什噶爾，贈槍支與小砲並訂立英阿條約，其後又自印度運來連發步槍與山砲，英籍退役軍官更在阿古柏軍中擔任顧問。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the western expeditionary army of the Qing Empire on one hand, and on the other the regime of Yaqub Beg fostered by the Kokand Khanate and styled the Hongfu Khanate, together with the Muslim armed groups of the various parts of Xinjiang. On the Qing side the supreme commander was Zuo Zongtang, who as imperial commissioner held full command over all three armies, with General Jin Shun as his vice-commander; the forward army under Liu Jintang numbered twenty-five Hunan battalions, the fourteen battalions under Zhang Yao and the five Sichuan battalions under Xu Zhanbiao, and together with the garrisons already holding posts in Xinjiang the horse, foot and artillery services together numbered more than one hundred and fifty battalions and close to eighty thousand men, of whom only some fifty-odd battalions and a little over twenty thousand actually fought at the front; in the rear General Yang Changjun sat at Guanzhong and at Suzhou raising money and provisions, while Zhang Yao and Huang Mian managed the transport convoys and the farming colonies around Hami. On the Kokand side, the Kokand Khanate, which nominally still acknowledged the Qing as its suzerain, had been controlled since 1870 by its regent Yaqub Beg, who established the state of the Hongfu Khanate in 1867 and stormed such cities as Turpan, Urumqi and Manas; under him served Kokandi Andijani infantry and cavalry recruited from Central Asia, Muslim troops who had followed the Shaanxi-Gansu revolt westward, and conscripted Uyghur, Hui and Han villagers. Urumchi, Turpan, Toksun, Manas, Daban, Kuqa, Kashgar and Khotan were held by commanders such as Bai Yanhu, Ma Rende and Ma Ming. Neither Russia nor Britain was a named belligerent, yet both fed the enemy from behind: in 1871 Russia took Ili with troops and sent caravans carrying large quantities of munitions over the Turugart Pass into Kashgar; in 1873 a British mission reached Kashgar with gifts of small arms and light guns and concluded the so-called Anglo-Kashgar treaty, and later consignments of repeating rifles and mountain guns were sent from India, while British retired officers served as advisers within Yaqub Beg's army.
people: 左宗棠是這場戰役的定策者。他一八七二年率湘軍駐兵蘭州，備戰收復新疆，定下「緩進急戰」的方針：緩進是用一年半籌措軍餉、積草屯糧、整頓隊伍、汰弱留強，急戰是因國庫空虛，大軍一出手便須速戰速決，力爭一年半左右取勝收兵。他在軍機處力抗李鴻章的海防論，主張西北「自撤藩籬，則我退寸而寇進尺」，終於獲文祥與慈禧支持，授欽差大臣全權節制三軍，並定下「欲收伊犁，必先克迪化」的次序。劉錦棠是前軍主將，一八七六年四月率主力出關，八月十七日自古牧地城牆缺口攻入，隨後乘勝收復迪化；一八七七年他以董福祥的董字三營為先鋒南下，急行軍一千二百餘里取達坂城，又在十二月中下旬收復喀什噶爾、葉爾羌、英吉沙爾與和闐。張曜與黃冕主持後路，在哈密開渠屯田，一八七六年收糧五千一百六十餘石，約可支半年軍糧；楊昌濬以總糧臺坐鎮關中籌款轉運。敵方核心人物是阿古柏，他一八七七年飲毒身亡，長子胡里殺弟自立、率殘部退保喀什噶爾，最後與白彥虎一同逃入沙俄。陝甘回軍頭目馬占鰲於一八七二年投降後被編入清軍。外交線上，崇厚與俄方所訂條約被左宗棠力斥為貿然割地，朝廷改派曾紀澤；左宗棠則自請屯兵哈密作談判後盾，並把棺木由肅州運到哈密，以示收復伊犁的決心。
peopleEn: Zuo Zongtang was the man who shaped the campaign. In 1872 he brought his Hunan troops to Lanzhou to prepare the recovery of Xinjiang and set the principle of slow advance and swift decision: the slow advance meant a year and a half spent raising money, stockpiling fodder and grain, reorganising the troops and weeding out the weak, while the swift decision meant that because the treasury was empty, once the army set out it had to strike and end the war within about a year and a half. In the Grand Council he fought the naval-defence doctrine of Li Hongzhang, arguing that in the north-west, if the barrier is withdrawn, the enemy advances a foot for every foot we give up, and with the support of Wen Xiang and the empress dowager he was appointed imperial commissioner with full command over all three armies and fixed the order of operations: to recover Ili one must first take Urumchi. Liu Jintang commanded the forward army; in April 1876 he led the main body out of the pass, on 17 August entered Gumul through a breach in the city wall and rode on to recover Urumchi, and in 1877 he sent Dong Fuxiang's three Dong battalions ahead as pioneers, marched more than twelve hundred li in forced columns to take Daban, and in the middle and latter part of December recovered Kashgar, Yarkand, Yengisar and Khotan. Zhang Yao and Huang Mian ran the rear services and opened channels to farm at Hami, where in 1876 they harvested more than five thousand one hundred and sixty bushels of grain, enough to feed that force for half a year, while Yang Changjun sat at Guanzhong as chief of supplies. On the enemy side the central figure was Yaqub Beg, who died by poison in 1877; his elder son Khuli killed his brother, seized power and fell back on Kashgar, and he and Bai Yanhu finally fled into Russian territory. Ma Zhanao, a leader of the Shaanxi-Gansu Muslim insurgents, surrendered in 1872 and was incorporated into the Qing army. On the diplomatic front the treaty signed by Chonghou with the Russians was denounced by Zuo Zongtang as a rash cession of territory, so the court replaced him with Zeng Jize; Zuo himself volunteered to garrison Hami as the moral support for the negotiations, and had his own coffin carried from Suzhou to Hami to show that he meant to take Ili back at all costs.
kits: 本卡兵器是英國一八六二年服役的鐵甲艦，即黑王子號那一代木殼包鐵的主力鐵甲艦：排水量設計約六千噸、滿載九千噸餘，舷側與水線帶包四吋半鍛鐵，主力為二十六門六十八磅滑膛前裝砲，另有十門一百一十磅與四門四十磅阿姆斯特朗後膛線膛砲，蒸汽機約五千七百匹馬力，航速約十四節。它在本場戰役中的位置是缺席而關鍵：新疆無海，鐵甲艦不可能開進天山，但一八七〇年代海上力量的分量正由這類船決定，英國靠鐵甲艦封住全球航路，喀什噶爾的商路與軍火正是在這套海上秩序之下運轉；清廷當時連一艘像樣的鐵甲艦都沒有，本場戰役只能靠騾馬、駱駝與人工維持數千里糧道，而這正是海防與塞防之爭的實質——李鴻章要把停撤之餉轉作海防之餉，左宗棠則要保住西北藩籬。真正壓倒守軍的是陸上重砲與後膛槍：西征軍以恩菲爾德改後膛步槍與施耐德步槍為主力，夏普斯與溫徹斯特連發馬槍供騎兵使用，前膛抬槍與鳥槍只作輔兵；火砲方面有西洋野戰銅砲、開花大砲（榴彈砲）、英國阿姆斯特朗後膛開花砲與普魯士克虜伯小口徑野戰砲，攻堅時則用蘭州機器局就地鑄造的生鐵劈山砲與抬砲，圍城挖地道逼近牆根、埋藥爆破。敵方裝備並不寒酸：英國自印度運來的恩菲爾德步槍、土耳其援助的舊式後膛槍、印度穆斯林老兵操作的砲位與本地土造火繩槍都見於戰場，但阿古柏一方沒有本土兵工廠，砲彈打發一發少一發，槍械一壞便成廢鐵。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the British ironclad of 1862, the wooden-hulled armoured capital ship of the Black Prince generation: designed displacement of about six thousand tons and over nine thousand tons at full load, wrought-iron belt and waterline armour four and a half inches thick, a main battery of twenty-six 68-pounder smoothbore muzzle-loading guns with a further ten 110-pounder and four 40-pounder Armstrong rifled breech-loading guns, steam machinery of roughly five thousand seven hundred indicated horsepower and a speed of about fourteen knots. Its place in this campaign is that of an absent presence with decisive weight: Xinjiang has no sea and an ironclad could never sail into the Tianshan, yet throughout the 1870s the weight of sea power was exactly what ships of this kind decided, for Britain locked the sea lanes of the globe with ironclads and the trade route and the munitions of Kashgar ran under that maritime order; the Qing court at the time possessed no ironclad worth the name, and this campaign had to be sustained by mules, camels and human labour over thousands of li of road, which is the substance of the dispute between the naval and the frontier doctrines - Li Hongzhang wanted the savings from abandoning the frontier turned into naval funds, while Zuo Zongtang meant to hold the barrier in the north-west. What actually broke the defenders was heavy artillery and breech-loading rifles on land: the western expedition fought mainly with Enfield rifles converted to breech-loading and with Schneider rifles, used Sharps and Winchester repeating carbines for the cavalry, and kept the old muzzle-loading matchlock and bird guns as second-line arms; its artillery included Western bronze field guns, shell-firing guns, British Armstrong rifled breech-loading guns and small Prussian Krupp field pieces, while for the assault on the walls it used the cast-iron Pi Shan cannon and the light field pieces cast on the spot at the Lanzhou arsenal, mining under the walls to blow them with powder. The enemy was not badly armed: Enfield rifles shipped from India, old breech-loading rifles from Turkey, gun positions manned by Indian Muslim veterans and locally cast matchlock muskets all saw service, but Yaqub Beg's side had no home arsenal of its own, so shells were spent one at a time and rifles that broke down became scrap.
tactics: 左宗棠定下的戰術核心是「先北後南、緩進急戰」：先取哈密、巴里坤穩住天山北路，再圖迪化，最後南下喀什、和闐，不在沒有把握的地方硬拼。緩進是糧道與行政：他在肅州設總糧臺，闢三條運糧線——由河西採購軍糧出嘉峪關過玉門運到哈密，由包頭、歸化經蒙古草原運到巴里坤與古城，由寧夏經蒙古草原運到巴里坤；大軍分作千人隊，隔日進發一隊，劉錦棠走北路、金順走南路，到哈密會合，穿越莫賀延碛流沙數百里，因水泉缺乏而不得不分期續進。急戰是作戰：清軍把砲火集中在城牆，一八七六年八月在古牧地以開花大砲轟塌城牆、十七日從缺口突入；次年攻達坂城先增築砲台，十九日一發打中城內彈藥庫，守軍死傷慘重而投降；托克遜城破之日更俘獲二萬餘人。攻城常規是步隊列陣、抬砲在前壓制城頭射擊，配合挖地道貼近牆根埋藥；野戰則以馬隊切斷敵軍糧道、襲擾側翼，逼守軍分兵。三路大軍的分工是：劉錦棠自烏魯木齊南下，董福祥為先鋒急行軍一千二百餘里取達坂城；張曜部與徐占彪部在鹽池會師後連克騰木、克辟展、勝金台直逼吐魯番；十月十八日取庫車、二十四日取阿克蘇、二十六日取烏什，十二月再越塔克拉瑪干沙漠收復喀什噶爾等四城。外交上則一面用兵、一面交涉：俄方在談判中索要通商、劃界與賠款，左宗棠上奏主張當先禮而後兵，自請屯兵哈密為曾紀澤作後盾，並分兵三路向伊犁挺進施壓。
tacticsEn: The core of Zuo Zongtang's method was to settle the north before the south and to advance slowly but strike fast: take Hami and Barkol first to steady the northern approaches, then move on Urumchi, and only then drive down to Kashgar and Khotan, never forcing a decision where he had no assurance. The slow advance meant supply and administration: at Suzhou he set up a chief supply office and opened three grain routes - grain bought in the Hexi corridor and carried out through Jiayu Pass and Yumenguan to Hami; grain carried from Baotou and Huihua across the Mongolian steppe to Barkol and to the old city of Jimsar; and grain carried from Ningxia across the steppe to Barkol. The army was broken into columns of a thousand men, one column setting out every other day, Liu Jintang taking the northern road and Jin Shun the southern, to join at Hami, the host crossing several hundred li of shifting sand in the Moheyan desert and therefore unable to march in a single body because the water was insufficient. The swift decision meant the fighting itself: the guns were concentrated against the walls, and in August 1876 the shell-firing guns breached the wall of Gumul, which the troops entered through the gap on the seventeenth; the following year, before Daban, gun emplacements were pushed forward, and on the nineteenth a single shot struck the magazine inside the walls, and the defenders, heavily casualties, surrendered; the fall of Toksun brought more than twenty thousand prisoners. The normal method at a walled town was to deploy the infantry in line with the light field guns in front to silence the walls, while sappers mined beneath the rampart to blast it; in the field the cavalry cut the enemy's supply lines and harried the flanks to force the defenders to divide. The three columns were allotted as follows: Liu Jintang moved south from Urumchi with Dong Fuxiang's pioneers, who covered more than twelve hundred li in forced marches to take Daban; Zhang Yao's and Xu Zhanbiao's troops, having met at Yanchi, carried on through Tengmu, Kebizhan and Shengjintai to press on Turpan; Kuqa fell on the eighteenth of October, Aksu on the twenty-fourth, Wushi on the twenty-sixth, and in December the four cities of Kashgar were taken after the columns crossed the Taklamakan desert. In diplomacy the campaign fought and negotiated at once: the Russians demanded trade, a frontier survey and compensation, Zuo Zongtang memorialised the court that courtesy should come before force, offered to garrison Hami as the prop for Zeng Jize's negotiations, and drove three columns towards Ili to put pressure on the talks.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。西征自一八七二年左宗棠屯兵蘭州備戰起，到一八七八年新疆大部光復，前後約兩年。軍費方面，左宗棠估算全部開支需白銀八百萬兩，申報朝廷一千萬兩，御批從國庫撥款五百萬兩，並准其自借外債五百萬兩。兵員編制：出師時劉錦棠部湘軍二十五營、張曜部十四營、徐占彪部蜀軍五營，加原駐新疆各據點守軍共馬步砲軍一百五十餘營，總人數近八萬，實際開赴前線者約五十餘營、二萬多人。行程與批次：主力自肅州入新至哈密約一千七百里，大軍分為千人隊、隔日進發一隊；其後自烏魯木齊南下攻達坂城，急行軍一千二百多里。糧食：哈密屯田一八七六年收糧五千一百六十餘石，約可支半年軍糧。戰鬥紀錄：一八七六年八月十七日清軍自缺口攻入古牧地，十一月六日攻克瑪納斯南城；一八七七年四月十六日兵臨達坂城、十九日城破，同月二十六日托克遜城破時俘獲二萬餘人；十月十八日取庫車、二十四日取阿克蘇、二十六日取烏什，十二月中下旬收復喀什噶爾、葉爾羌、英吉沙爾、和闐。外交與賠款：一八八一年二月二十四日《中俄伊犁條約》與《陸路通商章程》訂立，沙俄歸還伊犁九城，但割去霍爾果斯河以西土地，清廷賠沙俄兵費九百萬盧布，折合白銀五百餘萬兩；一八八四年十一月新疆建省。參照同代海上力量：黑王子號一級鐵甲艦排水量設計約六千噸、滿載九千噸餘，鐵甲厚四吋半，主砲二十六門六十八磅，蒸汽機約五千七百匹馬力，航速約十四節。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The expedition was prepared from 1872, when Zuo Zongtang garrisoned Lanzhou, and ended with the greater part of Xinjiang recovered in 1878, a matter of about two years. As to cost, Zuo Zongtang estimated the whole expenditure at eight million taels of silver and reported a figure of ten million to the throne; the imperial rescript granted five million from the treasury and allowed him to raise five million more as a foreign loan. On the order of battle: at the time of departure the twenty-five Hunan battalions of Liu Jintang, the fourteen of Zhang Yao and the five Sichuan battalions of Xu Zhanbiao, together with the garrisons already in Xinjiang, gave some hundred and fifty battalions of horse, foot and artillery and a total of close to eighty thousand men, of whom about fifty-odd battalions and a little over twenty thousand went to the front. On movement and marching order: the main body covered about seventeen hundred li from Suzhou into Xinjiang to Hami, the army being formed into columns of a thousand with one column leaving every other day, and the march from Urumchi on to Daban in the following year covered more than twelve hundred li in forced columns. On food, the farming at Hami yielded more than five thousand one hundred and sixty bushels in 1876, roughly half a year of rations for that force. On the fighting: the troops entered Gumul through the breach on 17 August 1876, the south city of Manas fell on 6 November, in 1877 the army was before Daban on 16 April and the town fell on the nineteenth, Toksun fell on the twenty-sixth with more than twenty thousand prisoners, Kuqa on 18 October, Aksu on the twenty-fourth, Wushi on the twenty-sixth, and in the middle and latter part of December came the recovery of Kashgar, Yarkand, Yengisar and Khotan. On diplomacy and compensation: the Sino-Russian Treaty of Ili and the Land Trade Regulations were concluded on 24 February 1881, Russia returning the nine cities of Ili but taking the land west of the Khorgos, and the Qing court paying nine million roubles of the cost of the Russian troops, equivalent to somewhat over five million taels of silver; Xinjiang was made a province in November 1884. For comparison with the sea power of the same moment: the first-rate ironclad Black Prince was designed for about six thousand tons and over nine thousand tons at full load, carried four and a half inches of armour, a main battery of twenty-six 68-pounders, machinery of roughly five thousand seven hundred indicated horsepower and a speed of about fourteen knots.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因是多層的。最直接的一層是一八六五年起浩罕軍事頭目阿古柏護送和卓後裔入喀什，逐步驅逐各路地方勢力，一八六七年另建洪福汗國，一八七〇年攻陷吐魯番、切斷北疆與河西走廊的聯繫，一八七一年再取迪化、鄯善、瑪納斯，同年沙俄乘虛佔領伊犁，清廷在新疆除塔城等少數據點外全部撤出。第二層是同治陝甘回亂自一八六二年起席捲陝甘、隴右、河西，西北邊防兵力長期被牽制；左宗棠一八七二年屯兵蘭州時已請命西征，直到一八七五年朝廷才在海防與塞防之爭中定案，李鴻章主張放棄塞防、承認阿古柏政權稱臣入貢即可，左宗棠力主塞防，理由是若失新疆則西北藩籬盡撤、防務不但不能減而必增，最終慈禧下詔授左宗棠欽差大臣。第三層是國際形勢：沙俄自一八六〇年代起在伊犁、塔城取得通商、免稅、自由居住與傳教等特權，並在喀什一帶設領事機構，英國則在喀什設領事、援助阿古柏，兩國在帕米爾與天山之間的中亞爭逐把新疆問題拖入列強角力。財政上這是一場超出常例的消耗，國庫只撥五百萬兩，其餘靠外債與各省協濟，遂迫使西征軍就地屯田、就地採辦。
causeEn: The war had several layers of cause. The most immediate was that from 1865 the Kokandi military chief Yaqub Beg escorted a claimant to the throne into Kashgar and gradually drove out the local contenders; in 1867 he founded the Hongfu Khanate, in 1870 he stormed Turpan and cut the northern Xinjiang off from the Hexi corridor, in 1871 he took Urumchi, Shanshan and Manas, and in the same year Russia occupied Ili while the frontier was unguarded, so that the Qing withdrew from all of Xinjiang except a few posts such as Chuguchak. The second layer was that the Shaanxi-Gansu Muslim revolt, which had spread through Shaanxi, Gansu and the Hexi corridor since 1862, tied down the north-west garrisons for years; Zuo Zongtang had already asked to go west when he garrisoned Lanzhou in 1872, and it was only in 1875 that the court settled the argument between the naval and frontier doctrines - Li Hongzhang proposed to abandon the frontier and merely recognise Yaqub Beg's regime on condition of his nominal submission, while Zuo Zongtang insisted on the frontier, arguing that if Xinjiang were lost the barrier in the north-west would be withdrawn and the defence would not be reduced but greatly increased - and the empress dowager finally appointed Zuo imperial commissioner. The third layer was international: from the 1860s Russia had obtained privileges of trade, exemption from duty, free residence and missionary activity at Ili and Chuguchak and had set up consulates around Kashgar, while Britain established a resident at Kashgar and propped up Yaqub Beg, so that the rivalry of the two powers in Central Asia between the Pamirs and the Tianshan dragged the Xinjiang question into the great-power contest. Financially the war was far beyond ordinary scale: the treasury gave only five million taels, the rest coming from foreign loans and provincial contributions, which forced the expedition to farm and to buy provisions on the spot.
impact: 收復新疆是晚清西部邊防的轉捩點。天山南北重歸中央有效管轄，一八八四年十一月新疆建省，劉錦棠出任首任巡撫，設道、府、州、縣，大辦屯田、編查戶口，把以屯田為經濟基礎、設官分理的治理模式推到極遠的邊地。外交上，一八八一年中俄伊犁條約使清廷收回伊犁九城與特克斯一帶，暫時堵住沙俄把勢力伸入天山南北的通道；英國的通商利益也以喀什噶爾的商路為前提，英俄在帕米爾一帶的角力則延續到一八九〇年代才由列強劃界暫時收束。戰略層面更見深意：西征驗證了塞防的主張，使洋務派內部分歧更形尖銳——左宗棠以西北為重，李鴻章、沈葆楨以沿海為重；與此同時，清廷第一批鐵甲巨艦定遠、鎮遠相繼由英國船廠建造、於一八八〇年代初抵華，排水量約二千二百噸，主砲為十二門十二吋口徑後膛砲，北洋水師於一八八九年成軍，鐵甲艦自此成為國家門面，也埋下一八九四年甲午海戰中北洋艦隊覆沒的伏線。將士與民間層面，左宗棠奏請為陣亡將士建祠祭祀，並在各省會立碑紀功，讓這場戰爭在清末的記憶裏留下確定位置；對今日新疆的行政格局與族群治理方式而言，其制度起點亦在此役。
impactEn: The recovery of Xinjiang was the turning point of the late Qing frontier in the west. North and south of the Tianshan returned to effective central control, Xinjiang was made a province in November 1884 with Liu Jintang as its first governor, and prefectures, sub-prefectures, departments and counties were set up together with farming colonies and household registration, carrying the model of frontier government based on military farms and appointed officials out to the far border. Diplomatically the Sino-Russian Treaty of Ili of 1881 returned the nine cities of Ili and the Tekes country to the Qing and for the moment blocked the road by which Russia might extend its influence across the Tianshan; the commercial interests of Britain likewise rested on the Kashgar road, and the Anglo-Russian rivalry in the Pamirs was not settled until the powers drew their lines in the 1890s. At the level of strategy the campaign carried a deeper meaning still: it vindicated the frontier doctrine and sharpened the quarrel inside the westernisation camp, Zuo Zongtang weighting the north-west against Li Hongzhang and Shen Baozhen, who weighted the coast. At the same time the first Chinese ironclads, Dingyuan and Zhenyuan, were built in British yards and reached China in the early 1880s, of about twenty-two hundred tons and armed with twelve rifled breech-loading guns of twelve inches; the Beiyang Fleet was formed in 1889, the ironclad became the face of the state, and the seed of the destruction of the Beiyani fleet at the war of 1894 was sown there. For the soldiers and for public memory, Zuo Zongtang memorialised the court to build shrines for the men who had fallen and to set up commemorative steles in the provincial capitals, and this campaign has held a definite place in the memory of the late Qing; for the administrative pattern and the governance of the peoples of present-day Xinjiang, its institutional beginning also lies here.
result: 結果是清軍收復天山南北，阿古柏政權覆亡。一八七六年四月大軍出關，八月十七日攻入古牧地、乘勝收復迪化，十一月六日克瑪納斯南城，天山以北盡復；一八七七年四月十九日達坂城光復、四月二十六日托克遜城破、俘獲二萬餘人，五月阿古柏飲毒身亡，其長子胡里殺弟自立、率殘部退保喀什噶爾；十月十八日取庫車、二十四日取阿克蘇、二十六日取烏什，十二月中下旬收復喀什噶爾、葉爾羌、英吉沙爾與和闐，白彥虎與胡里逃入沙俄，除伊犁外全境歸清。戰果之外亦有代價：西征陣亡將士以萬計，各家統計出入頗大；軍費總額約一千萬兩銀，國庫只撥一半；哈密與吐魯番一線的屯田解決了糧食，卻也改變了當地的地權與水源分配。伊犁一役則先外交、後兵威：崇厚與俄方所訂條約被左宗棠力斥為貿然割地，朝廷改派曾紀澤，兵分三路向伊犁挺進施壓，一八八一年二月二十四日《中俄伊犁條約》與《陸路通商章程》訂立，伊犁九城歸還，清廷賠銀五百餘萬兩。收復之後，清廷視新疆為不可分割的國土，一八八四年建省；左宗棠於一八八五年在福州病逝，諡文襄，曾國藩則稱他「論兵戰，吾不如左宗棠」。
resultEn: The result was the recovery of the lands north and south of the Tianshan and the destruction of Yaqub Beg's regime. In April 1876 the army went out of the pass, on 17 August it entered Gumul and rode on to take Urumchi, and on 6 November the south city of Manas fell, leaving all the north of the Tianshan recovered; in 1877 Daban was taken on 19 April, Toksun on the twenty-sixth with more than twenty thousand prisoners, and in May Yaqub Beg died by poison, his elder son Khuli murdering his brother and falling back with the remnants on Kashgar; Kuqa fell on 18 October, Aksu on the twenty-fourth, Wushi on the twenty-sixth, and in the middle and latter part of December came the recovery of Kashgar, Yarkand, Yengisar and Khotan, Bai Yanhu and Khuli flying to Russian territory, so that all of Xinjiang but Ili returned to Qing control. The victories had their price as well: the dead of the western expedition are counted in thousands and the tallies of different authorities differ considerably; the whole cost was of the order of ten million taels of silver, of which the treasury met only half; and the farms in the Hami and Turpan lines solved the problem of food while at the same time changing the distribution of land rights and water in those districts. The Ili affair was settled by diplomacy first and by armed pressure after: the treaty Chonghou had signed with the Russians was denounced by Zuo Zongtang as a rash cession, the court replaced him with Zeng Jize, and three columns were driven towards Ili to put weight behind the talks, until on 24 February 1881 the Sino-Russian Treaty of Ili and the Land Trade Regulations were signed, the nine cities of Ili were returned and the Qing court paid somewhat over five million taels of silver. After the recovery the court held Xinjiang to be an indivisible part of the realm and made it a province in 1884; Zuo Zongtang died at Foochow in 1885 and was given the posthumous name Wenxiang, and Zeng Guofan said of him that in the art of war he was not the equal of Zuo Zongtang.
